name: How do I choose a water damage restoration company?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a water damage restoration company?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a water damage restoration company, look for certified professionals (e.g., IICRC certified) with experience in water extraction, drying, and mold prevention. Check for positive customer reviews and ensure they offer 24/7 emergency services, as water damage requires immediate attention. Verify that they are licensed and insured in your area. Obtain a clear, written estimate and ask about their approach to communication and project management throughout the restoration process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a certified, experienced, licensed, and insured company with positive reviews and 24/7 emergency service. Get a written estimate and understand their communication process.
